title: In a Glass Darkly, v. 3/3
summary: "In a Glass Darkly, v. 3/3" by Joseph Sheridan Le Fanu is a collection of stories published in 1872. Presented as papers from occult detective Dr. Martin Hesselius, these five Gothic tales explore supernatural horror and mystery. A clergyman is haunted by a phantom monkey. A sea captain faces a sinister dwarf stalker. A cruel judge receives otherworldly justice. An Englishman falls into a deadly trap in France.
